'''Quincy Pondexter''' (born March 10, 1988) is an [[United States|American]] [[college basketball]] [[Forward (basketball)|forward]] at the [[University of Washington]]. He played high school basketball in [[Fresno, California]] at San Joaquin memorial High School where his father Roscoe and uncle Clifton Pondexter were All-American basketball players themselves and continued their basketball skills at the professional levels. At the end of his senior season, Quincy Pondexter was named an All-American Honorable mention by the Associated Press.<ref name="Mlive.com">{{Citation |url=http://www.mlive.com/broncos/index.ssf/2010/03/david_kool_is_ap_all-america_h.html |title=David Cool is AP All-America Honorable Mention |accessdate=March 29, 2010 }}</ref>
